name: hydra
description: Claude leads, cheaper agents (Heads, on Command Code, CodeBuddy, Codex or Antigravity) implement: /hydra turns it on, /heads watches them live, /hydra-usage shows both sides' limits

headModel.title: Hydra head model
headModel.description: Model the Heads run on (CodeBuddy and Codex ids have no provider prefix: deepseek-v4.1-flash, gpt-6.1-sol; switching to Codex picks gpt-6.1-sol on its own)

headEngine.title: Hydra head engine
headEngine.description: The CLI Heads run on: commandcode, codebuddy, codex or agy (Antigravity), or auto (the default): /hydra uses the engines that are installed and signed in here, and Claude picks one per Head when there are several; changeable with /hydra engine=<name>

headEffort.title: Hydra head effort
headEffort.description: auto (the Lead picks per Head: low when it can check the result, one level up per retry) or a level every Head runs at: off, low, medium, high, xhigh or max; changeable with /hydra effort=<level>

headsFiveHourUsd.title: Command Code 5-hour limit (USD)
headsFiveHourUsd.description: Your plan's 5-hour spend cap in USD; 0 shows spend without a limit

headsWeeklyUsd.title: Command Code weekly limit (USD)
headsWeeklyUsd.description: Your plan's weekly spend cap in USD; 0 shows spend without a limit

headsPlan.title: Command Code plan
headsPlan.description: Your Command Code plan name, shown in /hydra-usage (optional)

accountStrategy.title: Hydra account strategy
accountStrategy.description: With several accounts on an engine (/hydra accounts add): fill uses the default account first and moves to the next when one hits its usage limit; spread rotates through them, least recently used first

headReadDirs.title: Extra folders Heads may read in your home
headReadDirs.description: Codex Heads cannot read your home folder outside the project, except git's config and common toolchains (nvm, cargo, gradle, pyenv, Android SDK…). List more here, comma separated, relative to home (e.g. .sdkman, tools/bin). Credential folders are never opened.
